problem: The answer says adding y_j/D_ij is adding resistances in parallel. In Wilke's formula the friction contributions add, so the resistances 1/D_ij add in series, weighted by mole fraction. A parallel-resistance analogy would give the reciprocal-sum form, not the reciprocal-weighted sum used here. This can mislead students about the physical model.
fix: Say: adding y_j/D_ij is adding resistances in series, weighted by the mole fraction of each species; adding y_j D_ij would be a parallel-conductance average, which is physically wrong.
